scope: DEVELOPMENT only. Structural upper bound; CAL and C0-VALIDATION on HOLD.
sampler: Stim 1.16.0 circuit.compile_detector_sampler(seed=seed).sample(shots=50000,bit_packed=True) once; little-endian detector order; no logical labels
primary_graph: syntactic only; identical graph, whole-circuit noise and DD/boundary path rules as PR 222
primary_estimand: P(all clusters have both classes | nonempty syndrome). Every shot counted by frequency.
primary_interval: two-sided fixed-sample exact Clopper-Pearson 99%, conditional on observed number nonempty, model assumes independent identically distributed shots
threshold_rationale: Provisional engineering screen: at least one in twenty nonempty inputs must have the possibility of a fast-path decision; not derived from a measured runtime or user-specified target.
decision: NO_GO_5PCT if upper < 0.05; REACHABILITY_FEASIBLE_5PCT if lower >= 0.05; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. No PASS or error-risk conclusions.
guard: Fixed N. No early stop, sample replacement, alternate-mask analysis or threshold tuning. A validation disagreement stops the result. Source-enumeration controls and a deterministic multi-cluster/overflow control before sampling.
crosscheck: Independently determine clusters and overflow for all sampled patterns. Compare full per-cluster reachability for the preselected shot IDs 0,199,... (zero based) and every eligible nonempty shot using the archived half-path/matching verifier. Recheck all 1,679 original source patterns during controls.
descriptive: Report status counts for all shots; frequency by number of active detectors; empty fraction; count eligible / all. No decision or interval from subgroups.
budget: Oversized clusters always HOLD. An unhandled runtime or memory error invalidates the run; no relabeling.
